# ============================================================
# OPENFLUX EXIT NODE CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

# Secret key for encryption (generated by deploy script)
# Generated by: openssl rand -hex 32
# Stored in: /etc/openflux/secret.key

# OpenFlux L4 exit node configuration
# Run with: openflux run --mode=l4 --secret=/etc/openflux/secret.key --port=56004 --listen=0.0.0.0

# Configuration is passed via command line flags:
# --mode=l4                    # L4 mode (gVisor userspace proxy)
# --secret=/etc/openflux/secret.key    # Encryption key file
# --port=56004                 # Listen port (TCP)
# --listen=0.0.0.0             # Listen on all interfaces
# --share-host=YOUR_SERVER_IP  # External IP for clients
# --encryption-key-file=/etc/openflux/secret.key

# Systemd service: /etc/systemd/system/openflux.service
# [Unit]
# Description=OpenFlux Exit Node
# After=network.target
#
# [Service]
# Type=simple
# ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/openflux run --mode=l4 --secret=/etc/openflux/secret.key --port=56004 --listen=0.0.0.0
# Restart=on-failure
# RestartSec=5
# CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_ADMIN CAP_SYS_RESOURCE
# AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_ADMIN CAP_SYS_RESOURCE
#
# [Install]
# WantedBy=multi-user.target

# Firewall rules:
# iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 56004 -j ACCEPT   # OpenFlux L4 TCP
# iptables -A INPUT -p udp --dport 56000:56003 -j ACCEPT  # WDTT UDP ports

# Port mapping:
# OpenFlux L4: 56004 TCP (was 56000, changed to avoid conflict with WDTT DTLS on 56000 UDP)
# WDTT DTLS: 56000 UDP
# WDTT WireGuard: 56001 UDP
# WDTT Client: 56003 UDP
